name: nstyle-monorepo
description: Nstyle - Social Platform for Nail Art Enthusiasts

scripts.docker:dev: cd deploy && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.docker:dev:detached: cd deploy && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:prod: cd deploy && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:prod:monitoring: cd deploy && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile monitoring up -d --build
scripts.docker:test: cd deploy && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile testing run --rm test-runner
scripts.docker:test:watch: cd deploy && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile testing run --rm test-runner npm run test
scripts.docker:down: cd deploy && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml down
scripts.docker:down:volumes: cd deploy && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml down -v
scripts.docker:logs:dev: cd deploy && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f
scripts.docker:logs:prod: cd deploy && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f
scripts.docker:build:frontend: cd deploy && docker build -t nstyle/frontend:latest -f Dockerfile ..
scripts.docker:build:dev: cd deploy && docker build -t nstyle/frontend:dev -f Dockerfile.dev ..
scripts.docker:clean: docker system prune -f && docker volume prune -f
scripts.docker:clean:all: docker system prune -af && docker volume prune -f
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install

author: Nstyle Team
